imageSearchNotes: MS Learn's current Merge Transformation, Merge Join Transformation, and 'Extend a Dataset' walkthrough pages (checked live via browser, including the ?view= query string) are text-only with no embedded screenshots — confirmed with a DOM img-src scan. sqlshack.com's 'Using the Merge Join Transformation in SSIS packages' and 'SSIS Merge Join vs. Merge Transformation' articles together had the richest source material for this lesson, but most of the actual Merge Join Transformation Editor screenshots in both (ssis-merge-join-transformation-editor.png, merge-join-key.png, verify-join-type.png, change-join-type.png, select-merge-join-left-input-or-merge-join-right-o.png) have the author's own baked-in red box/arrow annotations and were skipped per policy; the clean Merge Transformation Editor and pipeline-diagram screenshots from these two articles were used instead. tutorialgateway.org's 'Merge Join Transformation in SSIS - Inner Join Example' (12 images, checked all) had no clean screenshot of the join-key grid either. A Medium.com walkthrough by Pooja Patil ('Merge Join Transformation in SSIS') filled the gap: it has three near-identical Merge Join Transformation Editor screenshots, one per join type (Inner, Left outer, Full outer); only the Inner join one is completely clean, the other two have yellow highlighter marks added by the author.
